map.输入真正、假正与假负，计算精确率、召回率与 F1 分数，适用于分类模型评估、阈值: Enter true positives, false positives and false negatives to compute precision, recall and F1, suited to classification model evaluation, threshold selection and imbalanced data diagnosis.
map.精确率 P = TP/(TP+FP)；召回率 R = TP/(TP+FN)；F1: Precision P = TP/(TP+FP); recall R = TP/(TP+FN); F1 = 2PR/(P+R)
map.P 与 R 天然此消彼长：放宽阈值召回升高但误报增多。F1 用调和平均综合两者，: P and R naturally trade off: a looser threshold raises recall but brings more false positives. F1 uses the harmonic mean to combine them and is more sensitive to the smaller one (as it approaches 0, F1 approaches 0), which makes it a good single trade-off metric; if the business cares more about misses (such as disease screening), use F2 to weight recall.
map.精确率 P=TP/(TP+FP) 衡量预测为正的纯度；召回 R=TP/(TP+F: Precision P = TP/(TP+FP) measures how pure the positive predictions are; recall R = TP/(TP+FN) measures how much of the positive class is covered.
map.F1=2PR/(P+R) 调和平均，二者冲突时综合评估。: F1 = 2PR/(P+R) is the harmonic mean and gives a balanced assessment when the two conflict.
map.阈值升高→精确率升、召回降；按业务代价选平衡点(如反欺诈重召回)。: Raising the threshold lifts precision and drops recall; pick the balance by business cost (for example anti-fraud weights recall).
map.：某模型 TP=80,FP=20,FN=10。阈值低时 FP 多 P=80/10: For a model with TP=80, FP=20, FN=10: at a low threshold FP is high, giving P = 80/100 = 80% and R = 80/90 = 89%; raise the threshold and FP drops to 5 but FN rises to 30, giving P = 80/85 = 94% and R = 80/110 = 73%.
map.漏检代价高时(癌症筛查、欺诈拦截)，宁肯多报假阳性也要少漏，优先高召回；再用人工: When the cost of a miss is high (cancer screening, fraud interception), it is better to accept extra false positives than miss cases, so favour high recall and then filter false positives with people or a second model.
map.PR 曲线和 ROC 曲线怎么选？: How Do I Choose Between PR and ROC Curves?
map.类别不平衡时 PR 曲线更敏感、更贴切；ROC 在平衡数据下更稳。AUC-PR: With class imbalance the PR curve is more sensitive and more relevant; ROC is steadier on balanced data. AUC-PR better reflects performance when positives are rare.
